meaning: Source/document review attestations, not proof of semantic correctness or issue completion.

agents.review_note: Checked role guidance and owner commerce report source. Campaign bookings use their own table and preserve valid empty order reports.

auth.review_note: Checked the booking ownership hash against login and logout behavior. A different browser or actor cannot reopen a paid booking.

commerce.review_note: Verified the reusable Razorpay identity and capture checks still feed the existing order writer for product purchases. Campaign payments write their own receipt.

content.review_note: Cross-checked exact paise, revision snapshots, independent controls, gateway configuration and the real local receipt and private attachment routes after simulated capture.

foundation.review_note: Reviewed the hosted database schema, deployment prerequisites and private file retention with the booking, verification, and storage implementation.

google-tags.review_note: Reviewed the frontend skill against the current reporting integration and the standalone private status template, which loads only same-site styling.

http-errors.review_note: Checked the booking-specific private error responses and the main response guard. Provider and database details stay out of browser errors.

interface.review_note: Reviewed the independent amount toggle, disabled preview, keyboard booking review, and private pending and captured cards against Design and the browser fixtures.

mail.review_note: Reviewed authored page and webhook writes against the transactional mail entry points. Existing enquiries and shop receipt mail keep their current paths.

mcp-clients.review_note: Reviewed the merged Integrations page references against the MCP client guide and approved route inventory. Display-group changes are owner navigation and preserve the client capability and config instructions.

media.review_note: Checked retained campaign file descriptors and protected streaming against Media Library behavior. Booking authorization is scoped to the frozen private manifest.

operator-help.review_note: Reviewed Pages guide walk-through against the authored editor, disabled preview, exact INR input and captured receipt entry points.

public-mcp.review_note: Checked registry additions and private booking collection ownership against the public MCP allowlist and its generated map.

remote-commerce.review_note: Reviewed the shared link verifier, signed endpoint and reference routing against both the existing product attempt and the new booking receipt.

sales-channels.review_note: Compared the MediaService additions with the Merchant Feed and product image inspection contracts. Header choices are filtered only for the owner authored editor, and catalogue image eligibility and feed URLs retain their existing resolution.

workflow.review_note: Reviewed the route registry and verified the new booking collection is wired to the database and campaign service in the generated inventory.
